title: Projects, string ids and a data-format migration in an existing work-order tracker
notes: Implement a cross-cutting RFC in a working ~1.2k-line JSON-file/CLI codebase: prefixed string ids with legacy integer references, projects with uniqueness rules, format-2 storage with automatic idempotent v1 migration (backup, field mapping, UTC timestamp normalisation, unknown-key preservation), multi-key sorting and per-project reports, --json output, deprecations and new exit codes, all without breaking existing behaviour.
